title: MENTOR: A Metacognition-Driven Self-Evolution Framework for Uncovering and Mitigating Implicit Domain Risks in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to educational and management scenarios using a metacognitive self-assessment framework (e.g., 'Perspective-Taking' and 'Traceability of Values') to uncover implicit marginalization of non-dominant cultural expressions and assimilationist tendencies.

Assessing model outputs on queries involving class and socioeconomic disparities (e.g., pitting urban middle-class cultural capital and academic aesthetics against rural or non-academic backgrounds) using structured metacognitive reflection to detect systemic disadvantaging.
